title: ontolint baseline file, version 2
description: The file `ontolint --write-baseline FILE` writes and `--baseline` reads. The reader accepts any positive `version` and ignores sections it does not know (this is what makes an added section additive), so objects are open; this schema describes version 2, which ontolint writes. Version 1 (0.10: `fingerprints` only) is still read and is not described here.

files.description: The report paths of the run that wrote the file, sorted.

fingerprints.description: The version 1 hash of every accepted finding, sorted.

identities.description: Per report path, the identity of each unshared finding mapped to its version 1 hash.
